messages.text:
PROMPT CH-4 — Replace ChatActivity.ConfirmationDialog (Material3 AlertDialog)
with ConfirmActionSheetV2, a HandyDesign-aligned ModalBottomSheet.

GOAL
- Stop using AlertDialog for dispatch_action confirmations.
- New sheet follows the same family as PrivacyDisclosureSheet and
  ModelPickerSheet (ModalBottomSheet, SurfaceElevated bg, CornerSheetTop=24.dp,
  PrimaryButton/SecondaryTextButton stack at the bottom).

DO NOT PAUSE FOR APPROVAL.

FILES TO CREATE
  app/src/main/kotlin/com/handy/app/chat/design/ConfirmActionSheetV2.kt

FILES TO MODIFY
  app/src/main/kotlin/com/handy/app/chat/ChatActivity.kt

SPEC — ConfirmActionSheetV2(reason: String, onContinue: () -> Unit, onCancel: () -> Unit)
- Use androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet + rememberModalBottomSheetState(
      skipPartiallyExpanded = true).
- containerColor  = HandyDesign.Colors.SurfaceElevated
- contentColor    = HandyDesign.Colors.TextPrimary
- shape           = androidx.compose.foundation.shape.RoundedCornerShape(
                       topStart = HandyDesign.Dimens.CornerSheetTop,
                       topEnd   = HandyDesign.Dimens.CornerSheetTop)
- dragHandle      = null (we draw our own — see below)
- tonalElevation  = 0.dp
- scrimColor      = androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color.Black.copy(alpha = 0.55f)
- onDismissRequest = onCancel

Content column (verticalArrangement = spacedBy 0.dp; manual spacers for control):
  1. Custom drag handle: Box centred horizontally, size 40.dp x 4.dp,
     clip(RoundedCornerShape(2.dp)), background HandyDesign.Colors.BorderStrong,
     wrapped in a Row with padding top=8.dp bottom=14.dp.
  2. Padding horizontal=24.dp from this point onward.
  3. Icon disc: Box, size 56.dp, clip(CircleShape),
     background HandyDesign.Colors.DangerSoft,
     border(1.dp, HandyDesign.Colors.Danger.copy(alpha = 0.42f), CircleShape).
     Inside: Icon painter=R.drawable.ic_phosphor_shield, contentDescription=null,
       tint=HandyDesign.Colors.Danger, modifier size 26.dp.
  4. Spacer height=18.dp.
  5. Title Text "Confirm action" — HandyDesignType.Title.copy(
       fontSize=22.sp, lineHeight=26.sp, fontWeight=FontWeight.SemiBold,
       letterSpacing=(-0.01).em), color=HandyDesign.Colors.TextPrimary,
       textAlign=Center, fillMaxWidth.
  6. Spacer height=8.dp.
  7. Body Text reason — HandyDesignType.Body.copy(fontSize=15.sp,
       lineHeight=22.sp), color=HandyDesign.Colors.TextSecondary,
       textAlign=Center, fillMaxWidth.
  8. Spacer height=24.dp.
  9. PrimaryButton(label = "Continue", enabled = true, onClick = {
        scope.launch { sheetState.hide() }.invokeOnCompletion { onContinue() }
     }) — but tint the button with Danger instead of Accent. Use the
     existing PrimaryButton in com.handy.app.design.HandyDesignPrimitives;
     it currently hardcodes Accent. To swap the colour without breaking
     other callers, add an OVERLOAD in HandyDesignPrimitives.kt:

       @Composable
       fun PrimaryButton(
           label: String,
           enabled: Boolean,
           onClick: () -> Unit,
           container: Color = HandyDesign.Colors.Accent,
           contentColor: Color = HandyDesign.Colors.AccentInk,
           modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
       )

     and have the existing single-arg PrimaryButton delegate to it with the
     default container/content. Re-use that overload here passing
     container = HandyDesign.Colors.Danger,
     contentColor = HandyDesign.Colors.AccentInk (still readable on Danger).
 10. Spacer height=8.dp.
 11. SecondaryTextButton(label = "Cancel", onClick = {
        scope.launch { sheetState.hide() }.invokeOnCompletion { onCancel() }
     })
 12. Spacer height = 12.dp (above nav inset).
 13. Closing Spacer(Modifier.navigationBarsPadding()) — the sheet host handles
     this automatically. Skip if double-padding.

State plumbing:
- scope    = rememberCoroutineScope()
- sheetState = rememberModalBottomSheetState(skipPartiallyExpanded = true)

NOTE: onContinue/onCancel must run AFTER the sheet visually hides; without
that the screen flashes the chat behind the still-open sheet for a frame
before navigation kicks in. The .hide().invokeOnCompletion pattern is the
same one the privacy disclosure sheet uses.

WIRING — ChatActivity.kt
- Add imports:
    import com.handy.app.chat.design.ConfirmActionSheetV2
- Replace the call site at ChatActivity.kt line 205-211:
      if (pending != null) {
          ConfirmationDialog(
              reason = pending.reason,
              onContinue = { onConfirmationResult(pending.id, true) },
              onCancel = { onConfirmationResult(pending.id, false) },
          )
      }
  with:
      if (pending != null) {
          ConfirmActionSheetV2(
              reason = pending.reason,
              onContinue = { onConfirmationResult(pending.id, true) },
              onCancel = { onConfirmationResult(pending.id, false) },
          )
      }
- Delete the private `ConfirmationDialog` Composable (lines 575-599).
- Remove now-unused imports from ChatActivity.kt:
    androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
    androidx.compose.material3.TextButton

DEBUG_LOG entries
  ## DL-CH-4 — ConfirmActionSheetV2 replaces AlertDialog for dispatch_action
  - Mirrors the PrivacyDisclosureSheet sheet family: ModalBottomSheet with
    skipPartiallyExpanded=true, CornerSheetTop=24.dp, SurfaceElevated bg,
    custom 40x4 drag handle, PrimaryButton + SecondaryTextButton stack.
  - Destructive action -> PrimaryButton tinted with HandyDesign.Colors.Danger
    instead of Accent. To avoid duplicating PrimaryButton, the existing
    PrimaryButton is extended with optional container/content colour params;
    all existing call sites continue to use the Accent defaults.
  - Sheet hide() is awaited via invokeOnCompletion before forwarding the
    accept/decline result so the chat behind doesn't flash.

STOP CONDITIONS
- ic_phosphor_shield drawable missing.
- PrimaryButton already has the proposed signature with different defaults
  (then just call it directly without modification).

Run ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug after the edits.
Additional stuff
A) Mention the change the code brings to the application - the before and after with real life practical examples if possible. 
B) Share an indepth end to end manual testing plan of the changes done - be practical and ensure all aspects are tested well before we proceed.   
C) ENSURE THERE ARE NO BUILDS ERRORS OR APP CRASHES. AUDIOT THE CODE COMPLETELY AND FIX ANY ERRORS

I’ll make this straight through: first I’m checking the existing sheet/button patterns and the drawable, then I’ll patch the new sheet and ChatActivity, update DEBUG_LOG, and run the Android debug build.

The shield drawable is present, so the stop condition is clear. I also see the worktree already has unrelated edits, including ChatActivity, so I’m going to work with the current file carefully instead of flattening anything.

I found the app already has a CH-specific debug log under `docs/DEBUG_LOG.md`, so I’ll append the requested CH-4 entry there. One implementation wrinkle: the current `PrimaryButton` has older parameters for width/chevron, so I’ll add the color-capable overload through a shared private implementation and keep the existing behavior intact.

I’m editing now: new sheet component in `chat/design`, swapping the chat call site, deleting the legacy dialog, and making the button primitive color-aware without changing its default Accent behavior.
The code path is now swapped over and the CH-4 log entry is in place. I’m doing a quick static audit before Gradle so the build failure mode, if any, is narrow and useful.

Static audit shows the old confirmation composable/imports are gone; the only “TextButton” hit is the intended `SecondaryTextButton` name. The host still has no system Java runtime on `PATH`, so I’m switching to the repo-local JDK that this project’s previous validation already uses.

`assembleDebug` passed cleanly with the repo-local JDK. I’m going one notch further on the audit now: app lint/unit tests where practical, plus a device launch/logcat check if an emulator is attached.
Lint and debug unit tests passed too. `adb` is not on the shell `PATH`, so I’m checking the usual Android SDK location before deciding whether a launch smoke test is possible here.

An emulator is attached through the SDK’s `adb`, so I’m doing a lightweight install/launch smoke now. This won’t manufacture a pending dispatch action, but it does catch startup/runtime crashes from the changed Compose graph and dependencies.

Implemented CH-4.

Changed:
- Added [ConfirmActionSheetV2.kt](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/app/src/main/kotlin/com/handy/app/chat/design/ConfirmActionSheetV2.kt:42): HandyDesign-aligned `ModalBottomSheet`, custom drag handle, shield danger icon, danger `Continue`, `Cancel`, and hide-before-callback behavior.
- Wired [ChatActivity.kt](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/app/src/main/kotlin/com/handy/app/chat/ChatActivity.kt:199) to use `ConfirmActionSheetV2` and removed the old private `ConfirmationDialog`.
- Added the color-capable `PrimaryButton` overload in [HandyDesignPrimitives.kt](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/app/src/main/kotlin/com/handy/app/design/HandyDesignPrimitives.kt:61), while keeping Accent defaults for existing callers.
- Added the requested DL-CH-4 entry in [docs/DEBUG_LOG.md](/Users/satvik.bansal/Desktop/Handy.android/HandyV2/docs/DEBUG_LOG.md:11).

**Before / After**
Before: when Handy needed confirmation for a real-world action like “call Alex”, “send this SMS”, or “share this text”, chat showed a Material3 `AlertDialog` floating in the middle of the screen. It worked, but it looked separate from Handy’s V2 sheet language.

After: the same confirmation comes up as a bottom sheet matching Privacy/Model Picker: elevated dark surface, 24dp top corners, custom handle, centered danger treatment, and stacked buttons. Practically, “Continue” now feels like a deliberate destructive confirmation, while “Cancel” cleanly backs out. The callback waits until the sheet hides, so navigation/action handoff should not flash behind a still-open sheet.

**Validation**
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `JAVA_HOME=/Users/satvik.bansal/.cache/codex-jdk17 ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug` passed.
- `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug` passed with the same repo-local JDK.
- Installed `app-debug.apk` on `emulator-5554`, launched the app to chat, and checked filtered logcat: no `AndroidRuntime`, `FATAL EXCEPTION`, Handy crash, or ANR hits.

**Manual Test Plan**
1. Trigger a dispatch confirmation from chat, e.g. ask Handy to call a contact, send a text, or share content.
2. Confirm the sheet appears from the bottom, not as a centered dialog.
3. Verify styling: dark elevated background, rounded top corners, 40x4 handle, shield icon, centered title/body, danger `Continue`, text `Cancel`.
4. Tap `Cancel`; sheet should animate down first, then the pending action should decline with no chat flash.
5. Trigger again and tap outside/scrim/back; it should cancel safely.
6. Trigger again and tap `Continue`; sheet should hide first, then the underlying action should proceed.
7. Repeat on gesture-nav and 3-button-nav devices to check bottom spacing.
8. Rotate or background/foreground while the sheet is open; no crash, stale confirmation, or duplicate callback.
9. Try a long `reason` string; body should wrap centered without clipping buttons.
10. Regression check Privacy Disclosure and Model Picker sheets still render normally.
11. Regression check existing Accent `PrimaryButton` usages, especially onboarding “Get started” / “Open Handy”.
12. Watch logcat during all paths for crashes or Compose runtime exceptions.

I also left the pre-existing unrelated dirty worktree changes alone.
